content.short: Derp Birds is a Cardano NFT collection and community centered on gamified collectibles and Derpetonia lore.
content.description: Derp Birds is a Cardano NFT project built around character collectibles, community humor, and a gamified roadmap. The collection expands through Derpetonia lore, Derplings, eggs, and PRED mechanics that give holders more ways to interact with the project beyond owning a profile-picture asset. Its appeal comes from a mix of meme culture, collection progression, and community participation, making Derp Birds one of the recognizable Cardano NFT communities for long-term collectors and fans in the ecosystem.
